blst -- BLS12-381 signature/curve library
upstream: https://github.com/supranational/blst
commit:   de54cd4684a3adba193a6c50ca5861c8c32c3b8a   (2026-08-18)
licence:  Apache-2.0 -- see LICENSE in this directory

Vendored subset (verbatim copies, no local modifications):
  blst.h, blst_aux.h   public C API (upstream bindings/blst.h, bindings/blst_aux.h)
  src/                 library sources; src/server.c is the single-translation-
                       unit build that #includes all the others
  build/assembly.S     assembly dispatcher
  build/elf/           ELF assembly for x86_64 and aarch64

Dropped: bindings for other languages (go/rust/python/java/c#/node/zig/swig/
emscripten), test vectors, docs/images, build/{coff,mach-o,cheri,win64} (other
object formats), src/asm/*.pl (the perl generators for build/*), and
src/blst_t.hpp (C++-only header).

Built by the top-level Makefile as:
  cc -O2 -fno-builtin -Wall -Wextra -D__BLST_PORTABLE__ -c vendor/blst/src/server.c
  cc -O2 -fno-builtin -Wall -Wextra -D__BLST_PORTABLE__ -c vendor/blst/build/assembly.S
__BLST_PORTABLE__ compiles both the MULX/ADX and the baseline x86-64 routines
and selects between them at run time via blst's own cpuid constructor.
